evidence.finding: Atomic Blast is a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super; unlock listed as Parallel Quest 87, Saiyan Battle.
All-186-PQ guide lists Atomic Blast under PQ87 Basic Reward.
2017 gameplay guide claims Ultimate Finish completion and a random drop were needed to unlock Atomic Blast.

resolution: Canonical record retains the maintained PQ guide's Basic Reward classification because it is the current repository's documented reward-tier evidence. The conflicting historical video is preserved as provenance context rather than converted into a new Ultimate Finish requirement or drop probability.
